note: Crew shuttles and home-port runs for NYC Ferry boats. Nothing here comes from the GTFS feed or the schedule workbook - both are silent about out-of-service moves - so this file is maintained by hand and must be revisited whenever the schedule changes. See ferryAssignments.md.

holidays.note: Dates that run the WEEKEND shuttle set even though the GTFS feed runs weekday service. calendar_dates.txt is empty, so the feed itself has no idea a holiday is happening - this list is the only source. Weekend-falling holidays are left out because they change nothing. Starting list only: confirm against the operator's holiday service before relying on it.

shuttles.note: One entry is one departure to the home port carrying the crews being relieved off the boats listed. 'landing' is a key in config/landings.json. 'boats' is the route code plus boat number, the same label the board badges - a boat named here is swapping crew, not finishing, so it is never marked out of service on account of the shuttle.
